name: A 683-Concept Block Replacement with Two Nonpeelable Wings
definition: Replace coordinate zero of the certified $267$-concept cornerless ample forbidden seed by a binary block. The original sections have orders $149$ and $118$, their overlap has order $59$, and their contraction has order $208$.
parameters: The replacement has $683$ concepts in $13$ coordinates; its negative overlap has $267$ concepts and the two exclusive wings have orders $90$ and $59$.
properties: The replacement is ample, cornerless, and pc-minimal outside dismantlable ampleness. Both sections are positive, but neither has a corner outside the negative overlap, so neither relative peeling can begin. Block size $m\ge2$ gives analogous examples of order $208\cdot2^m-149$ in dimension $11+m$.
